content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11001, SRS_Os_11010, SRS_Os_11013 If an OS-object identifier is the parameter of an Operating System module’s system service, and no sufficient access rights have been assigned to this OS-object at config- uration time (parameter Os[...]AccessingApplication, e.g. OsTaskAccessingAppli- cation ) to the calling Task /Category 2 ISR , the Operating System module’s system service shall return E_OS_ACCESS .
